title: Haye Akbar Ban'da Akbar (Punjabi)
body:
Haye Akbar Ban’Da Akbar
Haye Haye Dulha Ali Akbar (2)
Mursal Di Nishaani Ali Akbar (2)
Haye Yusuf-E-Saani Ali Akbar
Haye Akbar Ban’da Akbar..( 2)
1) Chod Gaya Hai Sughra Nu
Tu Toryaa Maut Diravate Te
Tenu Yaad Kara Lakhwari Mai (2)
La Qadm Nishaani Ali Akbar
Haye Akbar Ban’da
2) Wiraan Haveli Me Sughra
Karti Hai Yahi Ro Ro Ke Buka
Bin Tere Mere Bhai Ghar Me
Chayi Wiraani ali akbar.....
Haye Akbar Ban’da
3) Akbar Di pagh De Pech Bandah
Padi Piyu Saabe Innalilah
Aye Wegh Nabi Ya Nai Vikaya
Haye Haye Qurbaani Ali Akbar
Haye Akbar Ban’da
4) Paani Ne Kiya Matam Barpa
Us Dam Thi Hawaye Nauha Kuna
Jab Karbobala Me Mara Gaya
Hai Yusuf-E-Saani Ali Akbar
Haye Akbar Ban’da (2)
5) Karbobla Day Ban Vich Teri
Lash Te Ghoday Daud Gaye (2)
Karbal De Shahi da De Wangu
Be Misl Kahani Ali Akbar
Haye Akbar Ban’da
6) Jab Farsh-E-Aza Par Aatey Hai
Sab Ehle Aza Yehi Kehte Hai
Hai Gham main Tere Rukti Hi Na Thi
Ashko Ki Rawani Ali Akbar
Haye Akbar Ban’da
7) "Salman "Taqi Rokendey Nai
Rakh Maan Salamat Behna De
Armaa' n Raya'n Rabb-E-Akbar
Gairat Di Nishaani Ali Akbar ....
Haye Akbar Ban’da Akbar
Haye Haye Dulha Ali Akbar
